note: These modes are NOT ranked. A paired bootstrap over 10,000 resamples puts the 95% CI of every quality difference between bm25, dense and hybrid across zero at this sample size. Reproduce with evaluation/compare_runs.py.

significant_changes.change: bm25 vs hybrid, paraphrased queries only (n=64)

cross_encoder_rerank.why: Recall@10 rises while Recall@1 collapses. The demoted cases are procedures whose titles differ only by a qualifier (loai I / II / III, province suffix), which a general-purpose Vietnamese cross-encoder reads as equally relevant. Reranking before grouping instead of after does not help.

limits.lexical_bias: 41.3% of questions quote the target procedure title verbatim. Recall@1 is ~0.80 on those and ~0.62 on paraphrased ones.
limits.unreachable: Recall saturates by depth 50 (recall@50 == recall@100 == 0.9162), so 8.4% of questions never retrieve the correct procedure at any depth.
